verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a developer platform with CLI, API and MCP surfaces, but the evidence never documents a bulk or batch capability for operating on many items at once, such as bulk KV writes or batch API operations. Queues, Workflows, cron and the Code Mode MCP execute() tool are building blocks a developer or agent could use to construct bulk processing, so they earn no credit. The passing mention of a 'Workers AI batch request' in the event-subscriptions catalog only names an event type and does not document the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
